roleLifecycle: Native subagent handles are session-scoped, not durable app thread IDs. Persist role definitions here; recreate agents per session as needed. No persistent role sidebar chats are required.
fallback: If real subagents are unavailable, disclose this and run separate sequential role stages. Never claim independent agents ran.

concurrency.policy: Stage the five specialist definitions Planner, Coder, Tester, Reviewer and Small Edits within unchanged host limits. Parallelize only independent work with exclusive file ownership; normally Coder plus Tester preparation.

roles.name: Planner
roles.restriction: No implementation or test code edits

roles.name: Coder
roles.restriction: May read tests; must not weaken, delete or rewrite tests to pass

roles.name: Reviewer
roles.restriction: Strictly read-only: no file changes or commands that modify the tree or generate artifacts

roles.name: Small Edits
roles.owns: assigned compact, clearly scoped, low-risk production edits; coordinator reviews and validates
roles.restriction: May read tests; must not weaken, delete or rewrite tests to pass. No spawning agents, commits, installation or live Studio mutation. WORKFLOW-MODELS-02 exception: only the four assigned workflow documentation/configuration files.
roles.reasoningPolicy: Omit the reasoning override; inherit the normal harness default.

modelPolicy: Explicit user choices only: Planner gpt-6-astra/medium and Small Edits gpt-6.1-sol with no reasoning override; both fork_turns none. Coordinator, Coder, Tester and Reviewer configured defaults and global settings remain unchanged. Report unavailable requested models; never silently substitute.
deliveryPolicy: Prior authorization for local revision installation is separate from publishing. Do not publish, deploy or push without an explicit user request.
retirementPolicy: Archive these four recoverable chats only after workflow migration checks pass and changes are committed. Retired IDs are archive references only, not assignment targets; archive does not delete history.
instructionPrecedence: Later user amendments in workflowOverrides take precedence over conflicting original authoritativeInstructions; preserve TEAM-WORKFLOW.md verbatim and retain all unaffected rules.
dispatchPolicy: taskName values are reusable role dispatch labels, not durable live handles or sidebar thread IDs. Recreate session-scoped native agents as needed.
routingPolicy: Compact, clearly scoped, low-risk edits: Small Edits plus coordinator review and relevant validation. Substantial, ambiguous, security, network or architectural work: full Planner/Coder/Tester/Reviewer pipeline.
